1339-4050-7920.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

539-728-3249-4054--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1309-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1309-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2445-3099-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Innkeeper's Talent and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

140-6731-7433.description:
Activate Deepwood Ghoul by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1558-1671-2638-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-4365.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2532-4617-4906-7220.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4617-4906-7220.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Glamermite tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

343-2366-4068-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-4068-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You are the monarch.
343-2366-4068-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

436-2897-5220.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Gigantoplasm dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Gigantoplasm from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Gigantoplasm onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

14-141-6797.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

2173-5220-5231-6537.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

413-3168-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-3168-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-3168-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

618-1270-3719.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating three token copies of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When the Ruthless Technomancer tokens enters the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create two Treasure tokens,
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to sacrifice the first Ruthless Technomancer token and create two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the third trigger, causing you to sacrifice the second Ruthless Technomancer token and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate thee Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate a Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-673-864.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
372-673-864.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2713-4050-4242-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1715-1744-3096-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
1715-1744-3096-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Fleeting Distraction by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Fleeting Distraction targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Fleeting Distraction, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

618-2104-2556.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall with haste.
The token copy of Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

933-2724-3987.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Conjurer's Closet. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
